label: SIRC NZ GIS and Remote Sensing Research Conference
summary: SIRC NZ ran at the University of Otago on 29–30 August 2013 alongside the 125th New Zealand Institute of Surveyors conference. It was a distinct conference from the earlier annual SIRC colloquium series.
